name: Week Planner
note: Overlapping events are packed into columns per collision cluster and positioned purely from --t/--d/--x/--w custom properties on a subgrid whose sticky header shares the body's columns; drag empty time to create, drag a body to move across days, drag the foot to resize, every commit FLIPs and lands on an undo stack. Set --apl-week-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Month Board
note: Every week row is a subgrid of one seven-track month grid: multi-day events are greedily packed into lanes and placed with grid-column spans, a ResizeObserver measures how many lanes fit so the rest collapses into a +N popover, and the quick-add bar parses natural language (“oct 14-16 #ooo”, “fri 2-4pm”) into a live ghost on the grid before you commit. Set --apl-month-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Day Planner
note: Tasks drag from the inbox onto a single-day timeline where meetings and blocks share one overlap-layout pass and placement snaps magnetically to the nearest gap; Auto-schedule packs the remaining estimates and each task flies to its slot with WAAPI, while the capacity ring tweens registered @property values and prints its percentage through counter(). Set --apl-plan-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Find a Time
note: One minute axis in the chosen reference zone with every attendee's calendar and working hours re-projected through their UTC offset across day edges; a draggable, resizable meeting window reports each person's local time and conflicts, an All-required row shows shared hours, and a scorer ranks slots by who would be early, late or asleep. Set --apl-find-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Booking Page
note: A public scheduling page: availability is authored in the host's wall-clock time, converted to UTC with the offset in force that day and re-projected into the visitor's zone, so the October and November DST changes land correctly; the date grid is a roving-tabindex ARIA grid, time slots split into a two-step confirm with a grid-template-columns transition, and the confirmation tick is drawn by animating a registered @property into stroke-dashoffset. Set --apl-book-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Agenda
note: Sticky day headers inside the component's own scroller, rows revealed with animation-timeline: view() and a named scroll-timeline progress bar (both behind @supports, with a rAF fallback for the bar), plus an IntersectionObserver scroll-spy that keeps the mini month in step; travel time between places is computed per gap, and RSVPs collapse rows with FLIP and undo. Set --apl-agenda-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Room Booking
note: A floor plan and a rooms-by-hours timeline share one time cursor: scrubbing recolours every room from the same booking data and a registered @property animates each room's remaining-time ring; the plan pane is a size container that fits the drawing with cqw/cqh and redraws it rotated in narrow layouts, and dragging along a row books a slot with live conflict refusal. Set --apl-rooms-h to 100dvh in an app.

name: Leave Planner
note: A 365-cell year built from twelve CSS grids, coloured as a team-absence heatmap; drag or Shift+arrow across months to select a range, which is costed in working days net of weekends and public holidays and fed into a balance ring driven by a registered @property. Set --apl-year-h to 100dvh in an app.
